question: What are the four Major Learning Outcomes (MLOs) of the Integrated Sciences major?

- MLO1: Students will be able to critically analyze primary and secondary scientific research sources.
- MLO2: Students will be able to Apply appropriate qualitative and quantitative scientific methodologies in a specific field of the natural sciences to make evidence-based and scientific conclusions.
- MLO3: Students will be able to demonstrate foundational knowledge in the natural sciences and specialized knowledge in a focused area through effective written and oral formats.
- MLO4: Students will be able to demonstrate ethical conduct and social responsibility in scientific research.
